name: Ibuprofeon
look: a white Eeveelution with tan bandages, a blue-grey cone of shame, one red eye and an eye patch, dark red ear insides and a tail like a blister pack of pills
entry: An Eevee that hung on at the very edge of fainting evolved into Ibuprofeon. It is never without its bandages, and the pills on its tail ease the pain of any Pokémon that curls up beside it.
how: An Eevee that ends a battle on exactly 1 HP gets the chance to evolve into Ibuprofeon (accept it with the Evolve button). It learns Life Dew when it evolves.
